lesson_text: A trust rule must name what it trusts, never list what it distrusts: `check_review_runs()` excluded `workflow_dispatch` from the head-branch bound reviews, so `push` runs (internal-review.yml's no-PR route, which concludes `success` once a PR exists) and fork runs under the same branch name still counted; on a head branch only a same-repository `pull_request` run is a review of the PR.
